name: Rashid Floating Chat Button
author: Muhammad Rashid

sections.description:
Rashid Floating Chat Button is a lightweight, free WordPress plugin that adds a beautiful floating chat button to your website. Perfect for businesses and websites that want to provide instant communication with their visitors.

Key Features

  • Floating Chat Button – Eye-catching floating button that stays visible as users scroll
  • Mobile & Desktop Compatible – Works seamlessly on all devices
  • Customizable – Choose button position (left/right), visibility settings, and more
  • Click-to-Chat – Opens chat app on desktop and mobile devices
  • Custom Messages – Pre-fill messages for better user experience
  • Page Visibility Control – Show or hide the button on specific pages
  • Shortcode Support – Use [rfcb_button] shortcode anywhere on your site
  • Lightweight – No external scripts, SEO-friendly, fast loading
  • GDPR-Friendly – No user tracking, privacy-focused
  • Fully Customizable – Easy-to-use admin settings page

Perfect For

  • Business websites
  • E-commerce stores
  • Service providers
  • Support teams
  • Customer service
  • Any website wanting instant chat communication

How It Works

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Chat Button in the WordPress admin menu
  3. Enter your phone number in international format (e.g., +1234567890)
  4. Customize your message and button settings
  5. Save changes and the floating button will appear on your website

Shortcode Usage

You can also use the shortcode to display WhatsApp buttons anywhere:

[rfcb_button number="+1234567890" message="Hello!" text="Chat with us"]

Shortcode attributes:
* number – WhatsApp phone number (optional, uses default if not provided)
* message – Pre-filled message (optional)
* text – Button text (optional, defaults to “Chat on WhatsApp”)

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any user data. It does not use cookies, tracking pixels, or any analytics. The plugin only creates a link to WhatsApp when users click the button. No data is sent to external servers except when the user explicitly clicks the WhatsApp button, which opens WhatsApp (a third-party service) in their browser or app.

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit the support forum on WordPress.org.

Credits

Developed by Muhammad Rashid following WordPress coding standards and best practices.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Rashid Floating Chat Button”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  4. Click “Upload Plugin”
  5. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  6. Click “Activate Plugin”

Configuration

  1. Go to Chat Button in the WordPress admin sidebar menu
  2. Enter your phone number in international format (e.g., +1234567890)
  3. Set your default message that will be pre-filled when users click
  4. Choose button position (left or right side of screen)
  5. Configure visibility settings (mobile/desktop, page visibility)
  6. Save changes
sections.faq:
What format should I use for the phone number?

Use international format with country code, for example: +1234567890 (no spaces or dashes).

Can I customize the button appearance?

Yes! You can choose the button position (left/right) and control visibility on mobile/desktop. The button uses a modern green color scheme.

Does this plugin track users?

No. This plugin is GDPR-friendly and does not track or collect any user data.

Can I use multiple WhatsApp numbers?

Currently, the plugin supports one default number. You can use the shortcode with different numbers for specific pages or posts.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only loads minimal CSS and JavaScript. It does not use external scripts or APIs.

Can I hide the button on specific pages?

Yes! In the settings, you can choose to show the button on all pages, selected pages only, or exclude specific pages.
